text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 266-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 37.05 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
The average yield on an issue of 227-day T-bills on January 5 was 36.94 percent.
The series 22060 bills maturing September 17, the closest in outstanding maturity to the new paper, closed on Monday with a yield of 35.01 percent. Tuesday was a holiday in Russia.
Issue volume 7.50 trln rbls 7.50 trln rbls

Earlier, the Finance Ministry auctioned 4.00 trillion roubles of 154-day bills, raising 3.03 trillion roubles at an average yield of 36.77 percent. That takes total proceeds from today's auctions to 7.52 trillion roubles.

On January 8, the Finance Ministry is also repaying about 6.70 trillion roubles of maturing six-month bills (series 22038) and paying around 629 billion roubles in quarterly interest on the 18-month OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24005) maturing July 9, 1997.
The new bills are subject to the existing tax regime, which frees income from government securities from tax.

Parliament approved a 15-percent tax on income from government securities at the end of last year, but it has not yet come into force. Securities issued before the tax comes into effect will not be taxable.
